ingredient_groups.title: Dry Ingredients
ingredient_groups.body:
- **All-purpose flour**: 280 g
- **Cornstarch**: 19 g *(Note: In the video, Aaron mentions using 18 g or 19 g to soften the AP flour into a bakery-soft cake flour texture)* ([**0:59**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=59s))
- **Dutch-processed cocoa powder**: 13 g ([**2:07**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=127s))
- **Granulated sugar**: 350 g ([**2:22**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=142s))
- **Baking soda**: 5 g ([**2:22**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=142s))
- **Baking powder**: 5 g ([**2:22**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=142s))
- **Sea salt**: 5 mL ([**2:49**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=169s)) [[1](https://youtu.be/SB7z3sC0X2M#:~:text=These%20amazing%20red%20velvet%20cupcakes%20have%20a,cakes%20a%20festive%20and%20bright%20scarlet%20hue.)]

ingredient_groups.title: Wet Ingredients & Liquid Additions
ingredient_groups.body:
- **Whole milk (for vinegar mix)**: 120 mL ([**3:13**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=193s))
- **White distilled vinegar**: 30 g ([**3:13**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=193s))
- **Flavorless vegetable oil**: 200 mL ([**3:13**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=193s))
- **Vanilla paste (or extract)**: 10 mL ([**3:30**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=210s))
- **Large eggs**: 4 ([**3:47**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=227s))

ingredient_groups.title: The Hot Liquid Mixture
ingredient_groups.body:
- **Whole milk**: 240 g ([**4:19**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=259s))
- **Unsalted butter**: 60 g ([**4:19**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=259s))
- **Red food coloring**: 1 to 2 packets *(Aaron uses gel food coloring available in Austria)* ([**4:40**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=280s))

ingredient_groups.title: For the Cream Cheese Frosting & Topping
ingredient_groups.body:
- **Cold cream cheese**: 440 g ([**11:23**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=683s))
- **Butter**: 250 g (Slightly chilled, but soft enough to leave a thumbprint) ([**11:59**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=719s))
- **Powdered sugar**: 400 g *(Adjusted down from 600 g for perfect sweetness)* ([**13:21**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=801s))
- **Vanilla paste**: 5 mL ([**12:50**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=770s))
- **Walnuts**: An extra generous handful (Roughly chopped for topping) ([**17:12**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=1032s))

steps.title: Step 1: Combine the Dry Ingredients
steps.body: - In a large mixing bowl, weigh out 280 g of all-purpose flour, 19 g of cornstarch, 13 g of Dutch-processed cocoa powder, 350 g of granulated sugar, 5 g of baking soda, 5 g of baking powder, and 5 mL of sea salt ([**0:52**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=52s)). Whisk them briefly by hand ([**0:44**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=44s)). *You do not need to sift these ingredients, as the hot liquid added later will dissolve any small lumps.* ([**1:31**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=91s))

steps.title: Step 2: Add the First Round of Wet Ingredients
steps.body: - Pour 120 mL of whole milk mixed with 30 g of white vinegar directly into the dry mixture ([**3:13**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=193s)). Add 200 mL of flavorless cooking oil, 10 mL of vanilla paste, and 4 large eggs ([**3:13**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=193s)). Whisk carefully to combine ([**3:47**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=227s)). Because this batter is highly liquid, you do not need to worry heavily about over-mixing ([**3:55**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=235s)).

steps.title: Step 3: Heat the Milk and Butter Mixture
steps.body: - On the stovetop, gently warm 240 g of whole milk along with 60 g of unsalted butter until melted and hot ([**4:19**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=259s)). This warm liquid addition is an extra step that guarantees the cake crumbs turn out exceptionally tender and moist ([**5:05**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=305s)).

steps.title: Step 4: Color the Hot Liquid
steps.body: - Squeeze your red food coloring directly into the warm milk and butter mixture before adding it to the cake batter ([**4:40**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=280s)). Stir it well, adding enough gel until it reaches a deep, vibrant red hue ([**4:55**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=295s)).

steps.title: Step 5: Finish the Batter
steps.body: - Pour the colored, warm milk mixture straight into your mixing bowl ([**5:05**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=305s)). Whisk everything together thoroughly by hand until the batter is smooth, thin, and entirely uniform in its bright red color ([**0:44**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=44s)).

steps.title: Step 6: Scoop into Jumbo Muffin Pans
steps.body: - Preheat your oven to 160 °C ([**6:26**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=386s)). Line a jumbo-sized muffin or cupcake tin with liners ([**6:48**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=408s)). Using a large batter scoop, add roughly two scoops of batter to each cavity, being careful not to spill over the sides ([**7:00**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=420s)).

steps.title: Step 7: Bake and Cool
steps.body: - Slide the muffin tins into the oven and bake at 160 °C for exactly 20 minutes ([**6:26**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=386s)). Once a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean, remove them and allow them to cool fully before frosting ([**8:03**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=483s)). [[1](https://youtu.be/SB7z3sC0X2M#:~:text=These%20amazing%20red%20velvet%20cupcakes%20have%20a,cakes%20a%20festive%20and%20bright%20scarlet%20hue.)]

steps.title: Step 8: Frost and Decorate
steps.body: Once cooled, pipe or spread a generous layer of rich cream cheese frosting over the tops ([**8:03**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=483s)). *Aaron notes that he uses the exact same frosting recipe featured in his Hummingbird/Carrot Cake video.* ([**7:16**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=436s))
